hero.sub: Your digital catalog, ready in minutes. We review and activate it in under 24 hours.
hero.free_tier: 7 weeks free, no credit card required.

items.title: Online in minutes
items.body: No code, no designers. Set it up from your phone and it's ready the same day.

items.title: Orders via WhatsApp
items.body: Customers pick what they want and send you the order as a message. No apps, no sign-ups.

items.title: Your brand, your style
items.body: Your logo, colors, and business name. Your catalog looks like yours, not a generic template.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Just your email and your business name. Two minutes, for real.

steps.title: Add your products
steps.body: Photos, prices, categories. All from your phone. Like posting on Instagram, but better.

steps.title: Share and sell
steps.body: Copy your link and put it wherever you already are: WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Maps.

cta.headline: 7 weeks free.
cta.note: Your catalog goes live in under 24 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: We collect your business name, email address, phone number (optional), and the product information you add to your catalog. We do not collect payment data or access your WhatsApp account.
privacy.s2_body: Your data is used solely to create and display your digital catalog, send you account-related notifications, and improve the service. We do not sell or share your information with third parties.
privacy.s3_body: We use essential cookies to keep your session active. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy.s4_body: You can request deletion of your account and all your data at any time by emailing us at hola@catalog.mx.
privacy.s5_body: For any questions about this policy, write to us at hola@catalog.mx.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_body: catalog.mx lets you create a digital catalog to share your products via WhatsApp. The service includes a 7-week free trial with no credit card required.
terms.s2_body: You are responsible for the information you publish in your catalog. You may not publish illegal, misleading, or third-party rights-infringing content.
terms.s3_body: After creating your account, our team reviews and activates your catalog within 24 hours. We reserve the right to reject accounts that do not meet our policies.
terms.s4_body: After the free period, the service is billed monthly. You can cancel at any time from your settings panel. We do not issue refunds for partial periods.
terms.s5_body: catalog.mx is not responsible for transactions between you and your customers via WhatsApp. We are a catalog provider, not a payments provider.
terms.s6_body: For any questions, write to us at hola@catalog.mx.
